name: Mouhamed Gueye
detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Devin Carter
detail: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

name: Grant Williams
detail: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

name: Coby White
detail: White (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

name: Kon Knueppel
detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

name: Kylan Boswell
detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

name: Nic Claxton
detail: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

name: Caleb Martin
detail: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Fridays' game against the Pacers.

name: Jett Howard
detail: Howard (calf) is out for Friday's game in Indiana.

name: Tarik Biberovic
detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against Indiana.

name: Santi Aldama
detail: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

name: Cooper Flagg
detail: Head coach Dusty May said Flagg (shoulder) will be evaluated in the next couple of days, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Dereck Lively II
detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

name: Spencer Jones
detail: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.

name: Cameron Johnson
detail: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against New Orleans.

name: Alpha Diallo
detail: Diallo is questionable for Saturday's game versus the Pelicans due to a right wrist sprain.

name: Julian Strawther
detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Ausar Thompson
detail: Thompson exited Friday's game with an undisclosed injury and did not return, finishing with four points (2-5 FG, 0-1 3Pt), three rebounds, four assists, one steal, one block and three turnovers across 19 minutes in a 128-111 win over the Heat.

name: Jalen Duren
detail: Duren (thigh) exited Friday's 128-111 win over the Heat in the second quarter and did not return, finishing with four points (2-4 FG), six rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block across 10 minutes.

name: Charles Bassey
detail: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Moses Moody
detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Reed Sheppard
detail: Sheppard (knee) is out for Friday's game in San Antonio.

name: T.J. McConnell
detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against Dallas.

name: Ben Sheppard
detail: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Bradley Beal
detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Max Strus
detail: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
detail: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

name: Jordan Miller
detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Adou Thiero
detail: Thiero (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Jake LaRavia
detail: LaRavia (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

name: Cameron Carr
detail: Carr (oblique) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Cedric Coward
detail: Coward (wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Yves Missi
detail: Missi won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a left knee injury.

name: Otega Oweh
detail: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

name: Nikola Topic
detail: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

name: Thomas Sorber
detail: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

name: Anthony Black
detail: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Minnesota but participated in shootaround and has experienced no setbacks in his recovery, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
detail: Banchero didn't check back in during the fourth quarter of Friday's 115-93 loss to the Timberwolves after being deemed doubtful to return. He finished with 14 points (5-11 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 2-4 FT), six rebounds, five assists and one steal across 26 minutes.

name: Noah Penda
detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Tacko Fall
detail: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Dean Wade
detail: Wade is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks due to a left ankle sprain.

name: LeBron James
detail: James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Dominick Barlow
detail: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Luke Kennard
detail: Kennard (knee) is questionable to play Saturday against the Warriors.

name: Oso Ighodaro
detail: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as doubtful for Saturday's game against Golden State.

name: Mark Williams
detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

name: Branden Carlson
detail: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Ben Simmons
detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Dylan Cardwell
detail: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud
detail: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Tobias Harris
detail: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

name: Jayden Quaintance
detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
detail: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

name: Trey Alexander
detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: AJ Dybantsa
detail: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Jamir Watkins
detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
